title: DrugIntelHub
tagline: Searchable Intelligence Platform for Drug & Medicine Information
description: A searchable web application for drug and medicine information, built to give users clear answers quickly from a large and varied dataset. The React.js interface keeps searching and browsing fast, while a Python back end handles the data. Two databases are used on purpose: MongoDB for flexible drug records whose structure varies, and MySQL for relational data that needs strict consistency.
keyFeatures: Fast search and browsing across medicine records
Clear, readable record pages on mobile, tablet and desktop
Dual-database architecture (MongoDB for flexible records, MySQL for structured data)
Python back end built to handle large volumes of data
Secure HTTPS deployment
imageAlt: DrugIntelHub - Web Application for Drug & Medicine Information

title: Hindustan Franchise
tagline: Interactive Investor Directory & Franchise Enquiry Portal
description: A franchise directory website that helps prospective investors browse, compare and enquire about franchise opportunities. Structure came first: how listings are grouped, how visitors find the right category, and how few clicks it takes to go from interest to enquiry. Built on WordPress so the team can manage listings and content themselves.
keyFeatures: Category-based franchise listings that are easy to browse and compare
Enquiry and lead forms with email notifications
Easy content management through the WordPress admin
On-page SEO foundation so listings can be found through search
Mobile-responsive design

title: MyStikWrap
tagline: Full Website Re-Design, Architecture & Performance Tuning
description: A full website re-design for an existing brand that needed a cleaner look and faster pages. We rebuilt it from the ground up in React.js, keeping the brand recognisable while improving layout, speed and how visitors move through the site.
keyFeatures: Complete visual and structural re-design aligned with the brand
Performance tuning with Core Web Vitals in mind
Responsive layouts that hold up on small screens
Cross-browser testing across major browsers
Page layouts planned to guide visitors toward action

title: SksInfosystems
tagline: Hardened Corporate Security Platform & Service Showcase
description: A corporate website for a cybersecurity company, built to communicate security services clearly and earn trust quickly. Since we work in cybersecurity ourselves, we treated security and credibility as part of the build: a hardened setup, fast pages, and a structure that explains each service without drowning visitors in jargon.
keyFeatures: Dedicated, easy-to-navigate pages for each security service
Security-first configuration with HTTPS
Fast load times and a responsive layout
Professional, trust-focused design
SEO-ready page structure for service visibility

title: EcomBizGrow
tagline: High-Conversion E-Commerce Storefront with Speed Optimization
description: An e-commerce website built to make buying simple, from finding a product to checking out. The store has an organised product catalogue, payment and shipping set up, and product and category pages written with search in mind. It is tuned for speed because shoppers on mobile won't wait for slow pages.
keyFeatures: Structured product catalogue with category pages
Payment gateway and shipping integration
SEO-optimised product and category pages
Speed-optimised, mobile-responsive storefront
Simple store management through WordPress

title: Tacitine
tagline: AI-Powered Deep Packet Inspection & Unified NGFW Security Platform
description: A next-generation unified network security and deep packet inspection (DPI) platform engineered for hyper-connected enterprises. Defends enterprise digital infrastructure against zero-day exploits, advanced threats, and network intrusions with AI-powered DPI, real-time threat intelligence, and zero-trust policy compliance — all in a single, high-capacity scaling appliance.
keyFeatures: AI-Powered Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) & zero-day exploit defense
Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) with carrier-grade scalability
Zero-Trust network access (ZTNA) and policy orchestration
Real-time threat intelligence and automated breach containment
High availability architecture with 99.9% uptime and low latency
imageAlt: Tacitine - Next-Gen Unified Network Security & NGFW Platform
